summary: First-iteration end-to-end test of Pilares HVAC Supervisório (FastAPI + React + MongoDB with MQTT simulation). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass covering auth (login, change-password, me), fancoils (32 seeded CJ011..CJ172 w/o floor 13, SIM device_ids), commands (ESTADO forçado + CMD true -> status=true, CMD-in-AUTO 400, setpoint valid/out-of-range), admin (users CRUD, permissions, settings GET/PUT, detected-devices), alarms list, reports (commands JSON+CSV, hours-on, access-log), WebSocket snapshot+telemetry, and role-based 403s for viewer. Frontend: login w/ admin -> dashboard (metric cards populated via WS: 32/32 online, 1 forçado, 0 offline, 0 alarmes, 18.0°C), all 7 sidebar nav links present, /ar-condicionado renders 32 fancoil-card-cj* cards, detail page toggles ESTADO->Forçado + CMD->Ligar (indicator-comando=DESLIGAR after toggle), setpoint increment+apply works, range tabs 24h/7d/30d switch; Alarms page renders; Admin tabs Usuários/Fancoils/Broker e Parâmetros open; theme toggle works.

issues: Recharts prints repeated console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' when the chart container has no explicit minHeight. Non-blocking but noisy — add minHeight to ResponsiveContainer or parent.

action_items: Optional: fix Recharts width/height warning on FancoilDetail by setting an explicit minHeight on the chart container.
Note: admin password was changed from 'Admin@123' to 'NovaSenha123' during tests. /app/memory/test_credentials.md has been updated.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py.send_command: good domain validation (CMD blocked in AUTOMÁTICO, setpoint range enforced using fancoil-level min/max).
auth.py uses bcrypt hash + httpOnly secure cookie with SameSite=None, plus Bearer fallback — matches auth playbook basics. No brute-force lockout implemented (not in scope for MVP but worth noting).
seed.py.seed_admin: ensures role=admin and active=True on existing admin but does NOT reset password if admin password changes in env (idempotent as expected per spec).
routes.py._fancoil_out: safely strips Mongo _id and reinjects device_id — avoids ObjectId serialization pitfalls.
routes.py.report_commands CSV path with empty rows writes only two header columns ('timestamp','fancoil') — minor edge case but acceptable.
test_credentials: Admin felipejferreira@gmail.com / NovaSenha123 (changed from Admin@123 during test). To restore first-run behavior, drop db.users and restart backend.
seed_data_creation: No persistent test data created; TEST viewer user was created and deleted within the test suite. Admin password was changed to NovaSenha123 (persisted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py and must be run with `-n 0` to override the project-wide xdist loadscope config (otherwise sequential STATE between tests breaks). Admin credentials have been rotated; use NovaSenha123. Websocket URL pattern: wss://<host>/api/ws. Fancoil detail page uses testids: toggle-estado-button, confirm-estado, fancoil-power-toggle, confirm-cmd, setpoint-increment-button, setpoint-apply-button, indicator-comando, range-24h/7d/30d. Admin page tab labels are PT: Usuários, Fancoils, 'Broker e Parâmetros'.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Initial test-run false negatives were due to (a) test comparing email case-sensitively while backend lowercases, (b) assertion before STATE assignment causing cascade. Both corrected.
